data.one_liner: API to toggle fullscreen mode on web, desktop, and mobile Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: It exposes a FullScreen class that lets you enable or disable fullscreen and listen for changes. The implementation uses nativeapi for desktop and platform channels for web and mobile.
use_when: You need fullscreen mode on web, desktop, or mobile
You want to react to fullscreen changes in your UI
You prefer a single package instead of platform-specific code
avoid_when: You only target a single platform and have custom native code
You need advanced window management beyond fullscreen
You require a declarative widget approach
strengths: Listener mixin for easy state updates
weaknesses: Limited to fullscreen only, no other window controls
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, call FullScreen.ensureInitialized() in main, then use FullScreen.setFullScreen() or mixin FullScreenListener
